message.content: One of the most iconic sculptures of the 19th century is **Auguste Rodin’s “The Thinker”** (created in the 1890s and cast in 1902). Its dramatic pose and expressive form made it an emblem of modern sculpture and it remains a cultural touchstone today. Other notable 19th‑century works include Rodin’s “The Kiss” (1889) and the monumental “Statue of Liberty” (1886).
